title: Annual Report
summary: The ECB Annual Report landing page for 2024 provides summary statistics including headline inflation declining to 2.4% in December 2024 from 2.9% a year prior, and the ECB cutting interest rates four times for a cumulative 100 basis point reduction bringing the deposit facility rate to 3.00%. This is a navigation/index page linking to the full report, speech, feedback statement, and annual accounts rather than the substantive report content itself.
key_points: Headline inflation declined to 2.4% in December 2024 from 2.9% in December 2023, moving closer to the 2% target
ECB cut interest rates four times in 2024 with a cumulative reduction of 100 basis points
Deposit facility rate reached 3.00% following the rate cuts
ECB Visitor Centre hosted 21,325 visitors in 2024
Full 2024 Annual Report was presented by Executive Board member Luis de Guindos to European Parliament Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs
Annual Accounts are published separately in February, earlier than the main report in spring
why_it_matters: This landing page provides high-level 2024 ECB summary statistics but is not the substantive report itself. The headline inflation figure (2.4%) and rate cut summary (100 bps cumulative, 3.00% deposit rate) confirm the ECB's successful disinflation path and easing cycle in 2024. Investors tracking ECB policy normalization will need to access the full report for detailed assessments and forward guidance.
macro_context: The source confirms headline inflation approaching the 2% target (2.4% as of December 2024) and documents 100 bps of ECB rate cuts in 2024, representing significant easing. This reflects the ECB's response to cooling inflation and supports the narrative of a successful disinflationary path in the euro area.
